title: Accenture Technology Vision 2021: Leaders Wanted: Masters of change at a moment of truth
notes: Five trends, labels printed as 'Trend n: Name' with a subtitle (in note). Quotes are the trend sentences in the Introduction section 'Our Moment is Now: 2021 Technology Trends'. Publication month not verified: the executive survey was fielded December 2020 to January 2021, and the readable PDF is a re-export dated 2021-08-02. Survey figures were matched to their statements from PDF word positions (the number is printed before 'of executives ...'). The Introduction says the trends look at the coming years; no fixed horizon. pdftotext dropped spaces in some words; spaces restored in quotes.

entries.label: Stack Strategically
entries.quote: Competition is becoming a battle of technology stacks—and one size fits none.
entries.subject: Enterprise technology architecture
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Architecting a Better Future'. Survey: 89% of executives believe their organization’s ability to generate business value will increasingly be based on the limitations and opportunities of their technology architecture (no horizon).

entries.label: Mirrored World
entries.quote: As leaders thread technology through all aspects of the business, the valuable troves of data generated are being used to build massive networks of intelligent digital twins.
entries.subject: Digital twins
entries.metric: executives expecting their organization’s investment in intelligent digital twins to increase
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'The Power of Massive, Intelligent, Digital Twins'.

entries.label: I, Technologist
entries.quote: Enterprises can ignite grassroots innovation by equipping every employee with the tools and skills to build technology solutions at the point of need.
entries.subject: Technology democratization (low-code, no-code)
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'The Democratization of Technology'. Present-tense survey: 88% of executives believe technology democratization is becoming critical in their ability to ignite innovation.

entries.label: Anywhere, Everywhere
entries.quote: The single biggest workforce shift in living memory is positioning businesses to explore the benefits of a virtualized workforce and expand the boundaries of the enterprise.
entries.subject: Remote and virtualized work
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Bring Your Own Environment'. Present-tense survey: 87% of executives believe the remote workforce opens up the market for difficult-to-find talent.

entries.label: From Me to We
entries.quote: Multiparty systems will help businesses lead by changing the way they partner.
entries.subject: Multiparty systems (blockchain, shared data platforms)
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'A Multiparty System’s Path Through Chaos'. Survey: 90% of executives agree their organizations need to fast forward digital transformation with cloud at its core.
